content.value:
The FTC Driver Station supports two gamepads: gamepad1 and gamepad2.

gamepad1 is usually the driver. In this simulator, only gamepad1 is available.

Each joystick axis returns -1.0 to 1.0. left_stick_y is forward/back, left_stick_x is strafe, right_stick_x is turn.

You can control the virtual joysticks with the keyboard: WASD moves the left stick, arrow keys move the right stick.

Mecanum wheels let the robot move in any direction.

The standard mecanum drive formula uses four motors:

frontLeft = forward + strafe + turn
frontRight = forward - strafe - turn
backLeft = forward - strafe + turn
backRight = forward + strafe - turn

Where forward = -left_stick_y, strafe = left_stick_x, turn = right_stick_x.

Declare four private DcMotor fields: frontLeft, frontRight, backLeft, backRight.

In init(), get all four from hardwareMap: "front_left_motor", "front_right_motor", "back_left_motor", "back_right_motor".

In loop(), compute forward = -gamepad1.left_stick_y, strafe = gamepad1.left_stick_x, turn = gamepad1.right_stick_x.

Apply the mecanum formula to set all four motors.
